results.question:
Provide a comprehensive overview of proof theory. Cover its central methods and
results, its historical motivation, the principal figures, and its main
subfields. Aim for breadth across the whole topic rather than depth on any
single point.

Provide a comprehensive overview of Frege's theorem and its philosophical
significance. Cover the key logical result, the principles it relies on, the
problems it faces, and the program built around it. Aim for breadth across the
whole topic.

Provide a comprehensive overview of the theory of recursive functions. Cover the
main classes of functions, the central thesis connecting them to computability,
the key constructions, and the principal figures. Aim for breadth across the
whole topic.

Provide a comprehensive overview of common knowledge as a topic in logic and
the theory of rationality. Cover its definition, the formal treatments, the key
results, and its applications. Aim for breadth across the whole topic.

Provide a comprehensive overview of the logical system of Principia Mathematica.
Cover its goals, its central logical machinery, the difficulties it confronted,
and its significance. Aim for breadth across the whole topic.

Provide a comprehensive overview of the philosophy of Ibn Rushd (Averroes).
Cover his major works and commitments, his treatment of philosophy and religion,
his most influential doctrines, and his later influence. Aim for breadth across
the whole topic.
